d:
A large, bipedal Pokémon with a massive, armored build. The body is a metallic silver shade with deep crimson plating on the chest and head. It has a broad, armored head with a single, small, pale yellow eye on each side and two large, horn-like protrusions. It has heavy, armored arms with three claws on each hand. No tail.
BODY COLOR: metallic silver
